derived_from_batch02_failure_shape.observed_failure_shape: Batch02 confirmed that the confirmed-divergence veto direction still carries signal because raw_edge_h3 and avoided_damage_h3 stayed positive, but strict scoring remained narrowly negative because the veto set still appears broader than the truly harmful pre-move subset.
derived_from_batch02_failure_shape.refinement_reason: Batch03 keeps the same mechanism lineage and isolates only the selective toxic subset within confirmed-divergence instability so the veto can concentrate on the highest-conviction harmful structures instead of filtering all confirmed-divergence cases.

hypothesis_label: Confirmed-divergence instability should survive strict scoring only when the veto is restricted to the selective toxic subset

mechanism_contract.known_baseline_weakness: The primary baseline can approve pre-move setups that already show confirmed divergence, but it does not isolate which divergence-instability cases are actually toxic enough to justify a veto before expansion.
mechanism_contract.exact_mechanism_of_improvement: Replace the batch02 all-confirmed-divergence veto with a selective toxic subset state that vetoes only when confirmed divergence is paired with an additional deterministic toxicity signature showing instability persistence, failed re-stabilization, or similarly harmful pre-expansion fragility rather than merely noisy divergence.
mechanism_contract.why_not_parameter_tuning: The refinement changes the object being vetoed from the whole confirmed-divergence set to a new toxic-subset classification; it is not a threshold-only tightening of batch02.
mechanism_contract.why_expected_edge_should_survive_strict_: If batch02 failed mainly because over-broad veto coverage diluted the signal, concentrating the veto on the selective toxic subset should preserve avoided-damage signal, reduce false vetoes, and improve strict scoring without depending on a narrow calibration trick.

required_evidence_inputs: batch02 summary and compare evidence for phase69_instability_veto_confirmed_divergence
deterministic pre-expansion toxic-subset evidence that distinguishes harmful instability from salvageable noise
overlay/context suitability evidence from phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate only when used as optional secondary context
allowed_scope: confirmed divergence plus selective toxic-subset evidence before visible expansion
new selective fragility veto state derived directly from the batch02 near-miss failure shape
optional secondary compare against phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate for overlay/context suitability only
forbidden_scope: post-move hindsight labeling or toxicity definitions that need future bars
generic parameter-only pruning of batch02 without a new toxic-subset classification
